en: A black-and-white image featuring a landscaped park with a pond at the center, several small bridges, and swans swimming in the water. There are a few people strolling along the paths and a person leaning on a bridge in the foreground. In the background, there is a large stone building with a prominent tower, resembling a castle or fortified manor, surrounded by trees and other village buildings.
